summary:
Main
Prices recovered in November's first session, with futures, port and seaborne indices moving higher together. DCE most-traded closed at674.5 yuan/mt, up 0.37%; the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices each rose 3 yuan to 653, 605 and 815 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% and 65% indices reached USD 90.90 and 106.90/dmt, with most brand quotations firmer, indicating improved short-term price support.
